claims.statement: In the exercised installed environment and reviewed partitions, the candidate preserves successful archive, distinguishes no-trigger, unknown, and triggered trajectory states, performs one evidence-bounded project-level review, suppresses equivalent duplicate review, and authors one outcome-preserving successor while retaining owner boundaries for weaker or changed semantics.

population.partitionRule: Versioned reviewed disposable fixtures partition explicit Horizon linkage, archive applicability, repeated-touch and shared-owner triggers, forecast support, separated external cost, successor and protected-owner behavior, duplicate suppression, post-archive failure, and profile capability availability.
population.residualSpace: Other models, providers, host platforms, simultaneous independent horizons, unreviewed semantic trigger classes, long-running forecasts, organization portfolio planning, long-term delivery-time or defect-rate improvement, campaign consumption, consumer migration, and protected external effects remain outside the claim. The separate PMAC read-only diagnostic cannot close a generic member.

materialExclusions: Universal bottleneck discovery, forecast accuracy, or optimal architecture
Projects or changes without explicit Delivery Horizon participation
Automatic scope, population, quality, proof, safety, or protected-semantic reduction
Mutable roadmap status, velocity scoring, scheduling, or campaign execution
Consumer-project implementation, migration, controller contact, or runtime equivalence
Provider, model, host, or unreviewed trigger generalization
Installation, activation, remote mutation, deployment, release, credentials, or protected external effects
unknowns: No Horizon schema, trajectory-context helper, trajectory skill, profile closure, or OpenSpec routing candidate has been implemented or loaded.
No configured no-trigger archive or repeated-touch review and successor path has been observed.
No declared population member has a terminal runtime observation.
The separate PMAC read-only diagnostic has not run.
The required fresh broad-claim evidence-sufficiency challenge has not run.
claims.maximumSupportedClaim: Planning artifacts define the intended explicit Horizon, terminal post-archive signal, triggered review, duplicate-suppression, outcome-preserving successor, quality boundary, proof population, and implementation sequence; the bounded implementation-readiness challenge is closed for planning candidate r2, but no loaded runtime, forecast, cross-project effectiveness, successor behavior, or population-member claim is currently supported.
